title: EvoRouter: Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Routing via Insight-Guided On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Serving web queries at scale with multi-agent systems requires jointly configuring large language models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills. However, the resulting configuration space grows combinatorially, while sparse execution rewards provide limited fine-grained supervision for interdependent planning decisions. We propose EvoRouter, a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework driven by insight-guided on-policy distillation. A dedicated expert periodically synthesizes performance-cost feedback from configuration trajectories across tasks into reusable conditional routing insights about capability requirements, returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. A privileged teacher combines these evolving insights with current execution feedback to provide dense token-level supervision for the router's own planning trajectories through on-policy distillation. translated_title: EvoRouter：基于洞察引导的在线策略蒸馏的高性价比多智能体路由
translated_abstract: 使用多智能体系统大规模地服务网络查询，需要联合配置大语言模型、协作模式、智能体数量、交互轮次以及技能。然而，由此产生的配置空间呈组合式增长，而稀疏的执行奖励对于相互依赖的规划决策所能提供的细粒度监督十分有限。我们提出了 EvoRouter，一个由洞察引导的在线策略蒸馏所驱动的自演化多智能体路由框架。一个专门的专家模块会定期地将跨任务配置轨迹中的性能-成本反馈综合提炼为可复用的条件化路由洞察，内容涵盖能力需求、资源扩展所带来的回报以及不同配置选择之间的相互作用。一个特权教师将这些不断演化的洞察与当前执行反馈相结合，通过在线策略蒸馏为路由器自身的规划轨迹提供密集的 token 级监督。（注：原文摘要在“成本感知的强化…”处被截断，内容不完整）
tldr: EvoRouter 提出了一种由洞察引导的在线策略蒸馏驱动的自演化多智能体路由框架，通过将配置轨迹中的性能-成本反馈提炼为可复用的条件化路由洞察，并借助特权教师提供密集的 token 级监督，实现了高性价比的多智能体路由配置。
en_tdlr: EvoRouter is a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework that distills performance-cost feedback from configuration trajectories into reusable conditional routing insights, with a privileged teacher providing dense token-level supervision via on-policy distillation to achieve cost-efficient multi-agent routing.
